chips.note: no PD complete English; Bloomfield 1889 (Skt ed., PD); SBE 42 closest PD English

groups.heading: The three classical pairs (logic · metaphysics · exegesis)

chips.name: Nyāya — Nyāya-sūtra (Gautama/Akṣapāda) + Vātsyāyana's Bhāṣya

chips.name: Vaiśeṣika — Vaiśeṣika-sūtra (Kaṇāda) + Praśastapāda

chips.name: Yoga — Yoga-sūtra (Patañjali) + Vyāsa's Bhāṣya
chips.note: Woods, HOS 17 (1914) — PD; Rama Prasada SBH 1912 (US-PD); Bryant 2009 ©

chips.name: Mīmāṃsā (Pūrva) — Mīmāṃsā-sūtra (Jaimini) + Śabara's Bhāṣya
chips.note: Jhā, Śābara-bhāṣya GOS 1933–36 (PD); Sandal SBH 1923–25 (US-PD); no modern © benchmark

chips.name: Vedānta (Uttara-Mīmāṃsā) — Brahma-sūtra (Bādarāyaṇa) + bhāṣyas
chips.note: Thibaut SBE 34/38 (Śaṅkara) · SBE 48 (Rāmānuja) · Subba Rau 1904 (Madhva) — all PD; Gambhirananda 1965 ©

groups.heading: The Prasthāna-trayī — Vedānta's three pillars (all PD-shippable)

chips.name: Upaniṣads + Brahma-sūtra + Bhagavad-Gītā
chips.note: Upaniṣads (Müller SBE 1/15) · Brahma-sūtra (Thibaut SBE 34/38) · Gītā (Telang SBE 8) — all PD w/ Śaṅkara

zones.name: RING 3 — The Epics (itihāsa — "thus it was" — smṛti that popularizes the Veda)

groups.heading: The two great epics + their appendix

chips.name: Mahābhārata (18 parvas, ~1.8M words)
chips.note: Ganguli 1883–96 (US-PD; worldwide by inference — death date undoc.) · Dutt 1895–1905 (PD, documented); van Buitenen / Debroy ©

chips.name: Bhagavad-Gītā (in MBh, Bhīṣma-parva; a Prasthāna-trayī pillar)
chips.note: Telang SBE 8 1882 · Arnold, Song Celestial 1885 (PD); Wilkins 1785 (1st Eng.); Edgerton / Miller ©

chips.name: Rāmāyaṇa (Vālmīki, 7 kāṇḍas, ~24,000 verses)
chips.note: M.N. Dutt 1891–94 (prose) · Griffith 1870–74 (verse) — PD; Shastri 1952–59 (HOLD → 2027); Goldman / Princeton ©

chips.name: Viṣṇu
chips.note: Wilson 1840 (PD — the flagship Purāṇa); M.N. Dutt 1896; Taylor 2021 (CC-open)

chips.name: Bhāgavata (Śrīmad Bhāgavatam)
chips.note: M.N. Dutt 1895–96 (PD); Sanyal/Sinha (US-PD); Tagare AITM / Prabhupada ©

chips.name: Brahmāṇḍa
chips.note: no complete PD (embedded Adhyātma-Rāmāyaṇa: Baij Nath 1913 PD); Tagare AITM 1983 ©

chips.name: Mārkaṇḍeya
chips.note: Pargiter 1904 (PD; contains the Devī-Māhātmya); Coburn 1991 © (DM only)

chips.name: Bhaviṣya
chips.note: no authoritative complete; © partial only (heavily interpolated)

chips.name: Skanda (largest — 81,000+ verses)
chips.note: no complete PD; Tagare, AITM ~20 vols 1992–2003 ©

chips.name: Vāyu (Śaiva lists count it a Mahāpurāṇa in place of Śiva)
Devī-Bhāgavata

chips.name: Dhanurveda (archery / martial science)
chips.note: no standalone; PD via Dutt, Agni Purāṇa ch. 249–252 (1903)

zones.name: SIBLING BRANCH A — Āgama / Tantra (parallel revelation — NOT derived from the Veda)

chips.name: Woodroffe / "Arthur Avalon" corpus
chips.note: Mahānirvāṇa · Serpent Power · Hymns to the Goddess · Wave of Bliss · Principles of Tantra (all PD worldwide since 2007); Śrī Vidyā: Brooks ©

chips.name: Spanda Kārikā · Śiva-Sūtra Vimarśinī
chips.note: Kaul 1925 · Iyengar 1912 (PD — the thin PD layer)

chips.name: Pāñcarātra Saṃhitās (Ahirbudhnya · Lakṣmī · Jayākhya)
chips.note: mostly untranslated; Schrader 1916 (US-only study); Lakṣmī Tantra: Gupta 1972 ©

chips.name: Sikh, Gurū Granth Sāhib (adjacent religion)
chips.note: Macauliffe 1909 PD (selections only); complete = Gopal Singh 1960 ©

chips.name: Kannada vacanas (Basava · Akka · Allama)
chips.note: no PD corpus; Ramanujan, Speaking of Śiva 1973 ©

chips.name: Tirukkuṟaḷ (Tiruvaḷḷuvar)
chips.note: Pope 1886 · V.V.S. Aiyar 1916 (PD, complete) — nīti, not devotion

chips.name: Sāyaṇa (Ṛgveda-bhāṣya, 14th c.)

chips.name: Ādi Śaṅkara (8th c.)

chips.name: Madhva (13th c., Dvaita)
chips.note: Brahma-sūtra & Gītā bhāṣyas — Subba Rau 1904/06 (US-PD; worldwide likely)

chips.name: Cārvāka / Lokāyata (materialists)

chips.name: Saundaryalaharī / Ānandalaharī
chips.note: Woodroffe, Wave of Bliss 1917 (PD, half); N. Brown 1958 © (full)

chips.name: Anu-Gītā + Sanatsujātīya (in the Mahābhārata)
